mapper.select: SELECT CPC.REG_CODE PRD_REGIST_CODE, SUM(NVL(CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM.SINGLE_TOTAL,0) + NVL(CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM.LEGAL_TOTAL,0) + NVL(CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM.UNLEGAL_TOTAL,0)) holdCount, TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') HOLD_DATE, END_SUB.MDATE prdAclMDate, CP.ISSUING_STATUS prdIssueSts FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM LEFT JOIN END_SUB ON CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM.PRODID = END_SUB.PROD_ID LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO CP ON CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM.PRODID = CP.PROD_ID LEFT JOIN CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE CPC ON CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM.PRODID = CPC.PRODID WHERE TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM.HOLD_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND ((CP.ISSUING_STATUS != #{issuingSuccess,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR CP.ISSUING_STATUS IS NULL) OR (END_SUB.MDATE IS NOT NULL AND END_SUB.MDATE < CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM.HOLD_DATE) OR not exists (select 1 from chb_prd_issue_sub s where s.prod_id=CP.PROD_ID and s.send_status in ('02','03') and s.submit_feedback_status = '03')) GROUP BY CPC.REG_CODE, END_SUB.MDATE, CP.ISSUING_STATUS

SELECT DISTINCT CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM.PRODID, TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') HOLD_DATE FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM LEFT JOIN END_SUB ON CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM.PRODID = END_SUB.PROD_ID LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO CP ON CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM.PRODID = CP.PROD_ID WHERE TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM.HOLD_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND ((CP.ISSUING_STATUS != #{issuingSuccess,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR CP.ISSUING_STATUS IS NULL) OR (END_SUB.MDATE IS NOT NULL AND END_SUB.MDATE < CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM.HOLD_DATE) OR not exists (select 1 from chb_prd_issue_sub s where s.prod_id=CP.PROD_ID and s.send_status in ('02','03') and s.submit_feedback_status = '03'))
SELECT PROD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, SINGLE_TOTAL prdSingleTotal, LEGAL_TOTAL prdLegalTotal, UNLEGAL_TOTAL prdUnLegalTotal, VDATE prdVDate FROM OBJREC

SELECT A.PROD_REGIST_CODE prdRegistCode, A.SINGLE_TOTAL prdSingleTotal, A.LEGAL_TOTAL prdLegalTotal, A.UNLEGAL_TOTAL prdUnLegalTotal, A.VDATE prdVDate, B.HOLD_DATE holdDate, B.SINGLE_TOTAL investSingleTotal, B.LEGAL_TOTAL investLegalTotal, B.UNLEGAL_TOTAL investUnLegalTotal,
((case when A.SINGLE_TOTAL != B.SINGLE_TOTAL then 1 else 0 end) + (case when A.LEGAL_TOTAL != B.LEGAL_TOTAL then 1 else 0 end) + (case when A.UNLEGAL_TOTAL != B.UNLEGAL_TOTAL then 1 else 0 end)) errRecTotal FROM OBJREC A LEFT JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM B ON A.PROD_REGIST_CODE = B.PRD_REGIST_CODE AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(B.HOLD_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') WHERE ((case when A.SINGLE_TOTAL != B.SINGLE_TOTAL then 1 else 0 end) + (case when A.LEGAL_TOTAL != B.LEGAL_TOTAL then 1 else 0 end) + (case when A.UNLEGAL_TOTAL != B.UNLEGAL_TOTAL then 1 else 0 end)) > 0
select to_char(max(UPDATE_TIME), 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') value from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM
